name: Script Interpreter Execution From Suspicious Folder
description: Detects a suspicious script execution in temporary folders or folders accessible by environment variables
author: GAI_CTI
query: ((process.executable:(*\\cscript.exe OR *\\mshta.exe OR *\\wscript.exe)) OR (process.command_line:(*\ \-ep\ bypass\ * OR *\ \-ExecutionPolicy\ bypass\ * OR *\ \-w\ hidden\ * OR *\/e\:javascript\ * OR *\/e\:Jscript\ * OR *\/e\:vbscript\ *)) OR (process.pe.original_file_name:(cscript.exe OR mshta.exe OR wscript.exe))) AND ((process.command_line:(*\:\\Perflogs\\* OR *\:\\Users\\Public\\* OR *\\AppData\\Local\\Temp* OR *\\AppData\\Roaming\\Temp* OR *\\Temporary\ Internet* OR *\\Windows\\Temp*)) OR ((process.command_line:*\:\\Users\\* AND process.command_line:*\\Favorites\\*) OR (process.command_line:*\:\\Users\\* AND process.command_line:*\\Favourites\\*) OR (process.command_line:*\:\\Users\\* AND process.command_line:*\\Contacts\\*)))
